decisions.reason: The ID Vault document storage builds directly on the firm's digital identity and security expertise, so the firm can interpret early results and fold the feature into its super-app platform.

The identity-bound wallet draws on the firm's existing IAM and payment capabilities, but it overlaps with the payment and wallet framework and may be merged into it, which adds some risk of removal as a separate product.

NFC tag login sits close to the firm's core authentication know-how, but as a niche hardware-linked authenticator with only a brief mention it is more likely to be quietly dropped than the platform products.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and combines the firm's security and payment capabilities that feed the super-app ecosystem, so it fits the related knowledge base well.
The multi-service super-app platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction and builds on decades of security and identity knowledge, so it will be kept.
Application shielding is core application-security expertise backed by the firm's patented technology and has its own page, which makes it a well-absorbed and stable offering.
